metadata.selector: rare-element coverage plus deterministic farthest-point composition/size/distance sampling; at least 20 HCNOF molecules with >=8 atoms; at most five per source subset and six atomic/diatomic controls
metadata.note: Raw pool readiness flags are historical metadata, not proof of a newly qualified DZP-M SCF run. Convergence is accepted by the existing evaluator at training epoch zero; no finite-difference or CPU/GPU comparison is proposed.
